cleaned_body_text: Lucy Brake and Raewyn Peart. New Zealand has jurisdiction over a very large, varied and productive marine environment. It is of enormous importance to New Zealand in terms of economic, social and cultural values. With increasing interest in developing marine resources it is critical that we manage this marine area well. This book demystifies a complex and overlapping legislative framework by clearly describing how decisions affecting the marine area are made and by whom. It identifies how users of the marine environment, members of the public and others can participate effectively in these decision-making processes. Many activities can potentially cause adverse impacts on the marine environment, but these can often be addressed through the application of best practice approaches. By identifying the interests in oceans management this publication identifies a number of ways forward. It identifies the potential benefits of marine spatial planning and marine protection and describes their application. With the implementation of such approaches, coupled with best practice applied to marine and catchment activities, New Zealanders will be able to enjoy their oceans for generations to come. Sustainable Seas is an invaluable resource for all those who have an interest in New Zealand’s marine environment including the fishing, aquaculture, shipping and mining sectors, tourism operators, marine developers, recreational users, iwi and conservationists.
